**✨ Feature release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

The startup option is clearer: you can now open M.I.L.A **on its dashboard**, or leave it closed, without guessing.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Renamed and clarified**: Settings › Chat now has **"Open on startup"** with an explicit **Off** option — it keeps M.I.L.A closed and lets Obsidian open your notes as usual (this used to be the confusingly named "Dashboard").
- **Dashboard option**: pick **Dashboard** to open M.I.L.A straight on its dashboard (recent chats, modes) — no new conversation.
- **Chat / Vault Q&A / Agent**: still open a fresh conversation in that mode.
- Ships together with the mobile fix from 0.9.30 (the panel comes to the front instead of the editor).

### 🔧 Fixes & Quality
- New `startupOpensPanel()` helper, unit-tested; empty or unknown values still open nothing.
